title: Canonical Brand Root Workspace topology on current main

phases.objective: Bind Brand Create and legacy Dynamic Container projection to one canonical personal/company Root Workspace, preserve one deterministic Root-to-Brand containment edge, and fail closed on missing, invalid, ambiguous, stale, or noncanonical topology before durable authority convergence.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Brand identity, operational workspace, explicit Root binding, canonical containers, deterministic Root-to-Brand containment, closure readback, and authority epoch converge in one mutation transaction without projecting the operational Brand workspace as the authority parent.
steps: Resolve root_workspace_id against current workspace_registry ownership fields and require the exact active tenant, personal/company classification, ready bootstrap state, and personal owner identity when applicable.
Create or idempotently reuse the canonical Brand, tenant-brand link, operational Brand workspace, and creator Brand grant inside the container authority mutation transaction.
Persist root_workspace_id as operational Brand workspace provenance without classifying the operational Brand workspace as an ownership Root.
Create or reuse the canonical Root Workspace and Brand containers and require one deterministic contains relationship identity for the exact endpoint pair.
Rebuild container closure at the next authority epoch and require exactly one direct Root-to-Brand path before commit.
Invalidate the in-process authority cache after the mutation commits.
Build the legacy projection from the same Root binding and verify that it plans the Brand under the Root Workspace, not under the operational Brand workspace.

Reject apply before durable projection writes when Root evidence is missing, invalid, not ready, personal-owner incomplete, ambiguous, or represented by a noncanonical same-endpoint relationship identity.
assertions: Brand Create requires root_workspace_id and does not silently infer a Root from tenant membership or Brand workspace identity.
A personal Root Workspace without owner_user_id is rejected and a signed-in actor cannot create a Brand under another personal owner.
Operational workspace_type=brand remains an unclassified child/provenance row and cannot become the Brand authority parent.
The Root-to-Brand relationship uses the deterministic canonical relationship_id and a same-endpoint noncanonical relationship fails closed before duplicate insertion.
Exactly one active inheritance-bearing Workspace parent and one direct closure path are required before Brand Create commits.
Dynamic Container projection consumes config_json.root_workspace_id and blocks topology-invalid plans before durable apply.
No migration, Production mutation, provider call, credential read, external send, force push, or manual generated-artifact edit is performed by this slice.
